author: Institute of Marxism-Leninism (ed.)
title: Декреты Советской власти, том I: 25 октября 1917 г. - 16 марта 1918 г. (Decrees of Soviet power, vol. I)
publisher: Государственное издательство политической литературы, Moscow; transcribed by the electronic library of the Faculty of History, Moscow State University
notes: The Soviet scholarly edition of the decrees of the first months, transcribed page by page (the printed pagination is kept in braces) by the history faculty at Moscow State University and read here in full for the calendar decree of 24 January (6 February) 1918. It is an edition made by the state whose acts it prints, which matters for what is included and how it is introduced; for the wording of a decree it is the standard text.
